fieldData.name: TEDxAmsterdam 2026: After Growth

fieldData.descpiption: What happens when we rethink the spaces we live, work and move through? TEDxAmsterdam Conversations is a series of interactive events exploring the ideas shaping our world. This official TEDxAmsterdam Salon, in collaboration with Sir Adam and Dentsu Lab, explores how we can rethink space for a rapidly changing world. From homes and workplaces to digital and natural environments, join us to explore how smarter use of limited space can create a better-distributed future. Speakers announced soon.
fieldData.name: TEDxAmsterdam Conversations: The Role of Spaces in an Expanding World

fieldData.descpiption: We’re back from our summer hiatus with another co-hosted storytelling open mic night with Zoku Amsterdam. This edition is all about “Eureka!” — from accidental inventions to life-changing realizations, we’re celebrating those moments when an idea suddenly clicks or changes the way you see the world. Take the stage and share your story, or sit back and listen to aspiring storytellers. Hosted by Minna Taylor.
fieldData.name: Rooftop Open Mic Storytelling Night in Partnership with Zoku: Eureka!

fieldData.descpiption: After an intense 8-week mentorship, our eight 2026 Impact Pioneers are ready for the Zoku stage. Join us and experience them deliver powerful pitches on impact topics such as sustainability, education, and mental health. The stakes are high: two standout ventures will secure a spot on the TEDxAmsterdam main stage this November. Are you a founder, change-maker, or innovator? Join us for an evening of inspiration, connection, and networking!
fieldData.name: 2026 Impact Program Event

fieldData.descpiption: Our third co-hosted storytelling open mic night with Zoku Amsterdam is centered around the theme "Wrong Turn, Right Story," featuring true, first-person tales of mishaps and unexpected detours. Take the stage, or simply sit back and listen to aspiring storytellers. Hosted by Minna Taylor.
fieldData.name: Rooftop Open Mic Storytelling Night w/ Zoku: Wrong Turn, Right Story

fieldData.descpiption: This summer, TEDxAmsterdam is bringing big ideas and bold conversations to Tropikali Festival. In the middle of the music and movement, we’re creating a space for curiosity, connection, and fresh perspectives through inspiring speakers, a live moderated conversation, and an interactive TEDxAmsterdam booth experience. Expect thought-provoking moments, playful exchanges, and meaningful encounters woven into one of Amsterdam’s most vibrant and inclusive festivals. Come dance, connect, question, and imagine new futures with us under the summer sky.
fieldData.name: Tropikali Festival

fieldData.descpiption: The theme for this month: Join us for a special Open Mic Night at Zoku Amsterdam, themed “Great Loves” where true stories explore the love that cracked you open and changed your view forever. Step onto the stage or cheer from the crowd for an evening of heartfelt storytelling, hosted by Minna Taylor.
fieldData.name: Rooftop Open Mic Storytelling Night w/ Zoku: Great Loves

fieldData.descpiption: In collaboration with Sir Adam Hotel and Tropikali Festival, this edition of TEDxAmsterdam Conversations explores queerness beyond nightlife, highlighting culture, creativity, and the growing ecosystem of queer-led initiatives as Amsterdam moves toward World Pride 2026. Featuring voices like Venus Bijleveld (Ma’MaQueen) and DJ and community builder Lola Edo, and moderated by Terence Guiamo, the event brings together artists, ideas, and audiences in an intimate setting designed for real dialogue and shared reflection.
fieldData.name: TEDxAmsterdam Conversations: Embracing Queerness Beyond The Scene
